_notes.scope: P5.5 encoder only: no decoder, trajectory head, conflict head, loss or training. Randomly initialised weights are not meaningful features.
_notes.history_length: Not stored here: taken from the accepted window configuration (configs/phase5/window_generation_default.json, H = 6) or from the input tensors. With kernel 3 and dilations [1, 2] the temporal receptive field is 1 + 2 * (1 + 2) = 7 >= H = 6 (require_full_history_coverage checks this).
_notes.node_types_relations: Default context = pedestrian + vehicle with the three approved relations P->P, V->P, P->V. Bicyclist nodes come from COCO 'bicycle' detections (not evidence of a rider) and are off by default: enabling them needs node_types to include 'bicyclist', bicyclist_context_enabled = true and the relations B->P, P->B, B->V, V->B. V->V requires allow_vehicle_vehicle = true AND a Task 3 run that produced it (not the pilot). bicyclist->bicyclist does not exist.
_notes.feature_scaling: NOMINAL_DEVELOPMENT_DEFAULT_NOT_FITTED: fixed constants derived from the 1920x1080 / 30 fps geometry; NOT computed from the pilot or any dataset. A future training workflow supplies TRAIN_PARTITION_STATISTICS (fit_partition = 'train' + statistics_sha256); statistics fitted on validation/test data are refused.
_notes.position_mode: target_centred: u, v minus the target pedestrian's position at the LAST history sample (history only). Absolute pixel position is not an input.
_notes.use_edge_flags: false: the six Task 3 sensitivity flags (knn/radius/truncation) are diagnostic; set true only for the planned ablations.
